title: Daily Facts Volume Pilot
summary: Local notebook comparison of the first and last RTH hour on the same ES, NQ and GC session, using the pinned Daily Facts 1.0.0 release.
data_summary: June 28, 2021 through September 18, 2026. The notebook uses 1,303 paired ES sessions, 1,303 NQ sessions and 1,272 GC sessions with product-specific RTH windows.
evidence_status: Ten notebook cells executed in a fresh kernel. Independent calculations reconcile the saved estimates, denominators and exclusions. Results are descriptive for the retained population.
